extract_coords_from_complex: extract backbone coordinates and sequences from each chain of a biotite AtomArray protein complex structure
load_complex_coords: load backbone coordinates and native sequences for specified chains from a PDB or CIF file path
sample_sequence_in_complex: sample a protein sequence for a target chain in a multi-chain complex using a GVPTransformer model
score_sequence_in_complex: score a target sequence against a multi-chain complex structure and return average log-likelihood values
get_encoder_output_for_complex: get the encoder representation for a target chain within a multi-chain complex using a GVPTransformer model
